CQ01.text_it: Ai sensi del Regolamento (UE) 2023/1230, articolo 25, paragrafo 2, e allegato I, parte A, le categorie di macchinari elencate nell'allegato I, parte A, richiedono sempre una delle procedure di cui all'articolo 25, paragrafo 2, che prevedono l'intervento di un organismo notificato, come l'esame UE del tipo con modulo C, la verifica di unità (modulo G) o la garanzia qualità totale (modulo H).

value: risks of contact leading to hazardous situations
psychological stress that may be caused by the interaction with the machinery
CQ05.text: Under essential health and safety requirement 1.3.7 of Annex III to the Regulation, the risks addressed are contact leading to hazardous situations, contact that could lead to accidents (where risks persist), moving parts, accidental blockage of moving parts, and psychological stress from interaction with the machinery.

steps.text: essential requirement 1.3.7: addressesRisk = risks of contact leading to hazardous situations
steps.quote: The prevention of risks of contact leading to hazardous situations and the psychological stress that may be caused by the interaction with the machinery shall be adapted to: (a) human-machine coexistence in a shared space without direct collaboration; (b) human-machine interaction.

steps.text: essential requirement 1.3.7: addressesRisk = risks of contact which could lead to accidents (condition: where risks persist)
steps.quote: Risks related to moving parts The moving parts of the machinery or related product shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent risks of contact which could lead to accidents or shall, where risks persist, be fitted with guards or protective devices.

steps.text: essential requirement 1.3.7: addressesRisk = Risks related to moving parts
steps.quote: Risks related to moving parts The moving parts of the machinery or related product shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent risks of contact which could lead to accidents or shall, where risks persist, be fitted with guards or protective devices.

steps.text: essential requirement 1.3.7: addressesRisk = accidental blockage of moving parts
steps.quote: All necessary steps shall be taken to prevent accidental blockage of moving parts.

steps.text: essential requirement 1.3.7: addressesRisk = psychological stress that may be caused by the interaction with the machinery
steps.quote: The prevention of risks of contact leading to hazardous situations and the psychological stress that may be caused by the interaction with the machinery shall be adapted to: (a) human-machine coexistence in a shared space without direct collaboration; (b) human-machine interaction.

CQ05.text_it: Ai sensi del requisito essenziale di salute e sicurezza 1.3.7 dell'Allegato III del Regolamento, i rischi affrontati sono il contatto che può portare a situazioni pericolose, il contatto che potrebbe portare a incidenti (laddove i rischi persistono), le parti in movimento, il blocco accidentale delle parti in movimento e lo stress psicologico derivante dall'interazione con la macchina.

CQ06.value: The natural or legal person who carries out the substantial modification is treated as the manufacturer under Article 18 of the Machinery Regulation, subject to the Article 10 manufacturer obligations (where the modification affects only the safety of machinery or a related product forming part of an assembly).
CQ06.text: Under Article 18 of the Machinery Regulation, the natural or legal person carrying out a substantial modification is subject to the manufacturer's obligations in Article 10, provided the modification affects only the safety of that machinery or a related product within an assembly; a non-professional user modifying machinery for own use is excluded.

steps.text: natural or legal person carrying out substantial modification: hasObligation = shall be subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in Article 10 (condition: if the substantial modification has an impact on the safety of only machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly of machinery)
steps.quote: Article 18 Other cases in which obligations of manufacturers apply A natural or legal person that carries out a substantial modification of machinery or a related product shall be considered to be a manufacturer for the purposes of this Regulation and shall be subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in Article 10 for that machinery or related product or, if the substantial modification has an impact on the safety of only machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly of machinery, for that affected machinery or related product, as demonstrated in the risk assessment.

steps.text: person who carries out substantial modification: hasObligation = ensure and declare on its sole responsibility
steps.quote: The person who carries out the substantial modification shall in particular, but without prejudice to other obligations set out in Article 10, ensure and declare on its sole responsibility that the machinery or related product concerned is in conformity with the applicable requirements of this Regulation and shall apply the relevant conformity assessment procedure as provided in Article 25 (2), (3) and (4) of this Regulation.

steps.text: non-professional user modifying machinery for own use: becomesManufacturer = shall not be considered to be a manufacturer (condition: for his or her own use)
steps.quote: A non-professional user who carries out a substantial modification to his or her machinery or related product, for his or her own use, shall not be considered to be a manufacturer for the purposes of this Regulation and shall not be subject to the obligations on the manufacturer set out in Article 10.

steps.text: non-professional user modifying machinery for own use: hasObligation = shall not be subject to the obligations on the manufacturer set out in Article 10 (condition: for his or her own use)
steps.quote: A non-professional user who carries out a substantial modification to his or her machinery or related product, for his or her own use, shall not be considered to be a manufacturer for the purposes of this Regulation and shall not be subject to the obligations on the manufacturer set out in Article 10.

CQ06.text_it: Ai sensi dell'articolo 18 del regolamento sulle macchine, la persona fisica o giuridica che effettua una modifica sostanziale è soggetta agli obblighi del fabbricante di cui all'articolo 10, a condizione che la modifica riguardi solo la sicurezza di tale macchina o di un prodotto correlato all'interno di un insieme; un utilizzatore non professionale che modifica una macchina per uso proprio è escluso.
